changes.after: The toolchain requires Python 3.12 or later and uses the repository's own test suite in tests/ to validate functionality. Contributors must ensure all tests pass before submitting changes, following the rules defined by the project's testing standards. Runnable example scripts and what each one demonstrates are listed in the examples/README.md file. The examples/ directory provides runnable samples that demonstrate member AUTO, member H, member data, member render, member to_png, and member to_svg usage. Running the test suite from the repository root verifies that the package behaves as expected across supported scenarios.
